  PROBLEM: The security pass can be marked clean when every earlier follow-up is closed and labelled `ai:merged`, even though the current audit reports surviving findings.
  WHY: A re-detected finding can have `findings > 0` and `followups_created=0` because its existing finding marker suppresses a new follow-up, so the OR condition advances the project with an unresolved vulnerability; five reviewers rated this BLOCKER and qwen_qwen3_7-plus rated it MAJOR.
- tests/test_escalation_judge_command.py:313 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The test for the security clean-pass rule checks that the rule is present but does not assert that a current audit with findings and no new follow-up is not clean.
  WHY: The regression scenario can remain untested, allowing the faulty clean-pass logic to pass the contract test.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- requirement: "A pass is now clean only when the audit reported `findings=0` or every listed follow-up is closed with `ai:merged`; a listed follow-up still open and not blocked re-arms the issue-list wait, and a blocked or unmerged one is `security-followup-unmerged` again"

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:74 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The security clean-pass check treats the pass as clean when every previously logged follow-up is closed and labelled `ai:merged`, even when the current audit reports findings greater than zero and creates no follow-ups.
  WHY: A re-detected finding can be deduplicated against a closed follow-up, so the project advances to validation or completion with an unfixed vulnerability.

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:line 74 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: A successful security audit is treated as clean when earlier follow-up issues are closed and labelled `ai:merged`, even if the current audit reports surviving findings.
  WHY: A re-detected finding can have `findings > 0` and `followups_created=0`, yet the earlier merged follow-up condition permits code with an unmitigated vulnerability to pass the security gate.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:line 74 (the `Conclusion success and no follow-up issues opened, or the run skipped as unchanged` bullet in step 9) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The clean-pass rule treats the audit as clean when every previously logged follow-up is closed and labelled `ai:merged`, even when the current audit reports findings.
  WHY: A re-detected finding can yield `findings > 0` with `followups_created = 0`, causing the project to advance to validation with an unresolved security finding.
- tests/test_escalation_judge_command.py::test_security_clean_pass_checks_earlier_followups | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The test verifies the “every prior follow-up closed and ai:merged” branch but does not cover a current audit with findings that creates no new follow-up because a prior follow-up is closed and merged.
  WHY: The regression can be reintroduced without the test detecting it.

TASK_GAP
Requirement: "A pass is now clean only when the audit reported `findings=0` or every listed follow-up is closed with `ai:merged`; a listed follow-up still open and not blocked re-arms the issue-list wait, and a blocked or unmerged one is `security-followup-unmerged` again" (from the PR description / progress log AD-18).
Expected change site: workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:74 (the security pass clean criteria) and tests/test_escalation_judge_command.py::test_security_clean_pass_checks_earlier_followups.
Evidence of absence: The new condition `or when every follow-up issue the log's ## Security pass lists from earlier cycles is closed and labelled ai:merged` does not AND with `findings=0` in the case where a re-detected finding reuses a closed/merged marker's id. The audit's `summary.py` segment counts surviving findings and follow-ups independently, and lines 1693-1700 only short-circuit a new follow-up, not the existence of the finding. The clean-pass gate therefore evaluates true on a real `findings > 0` run. The contract test added in this round does not exercise the failing scenario.
SEVERITY: BLOCKER
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:Line 74; scripts/security_audit.sh lines 1693–1700 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The security pass can be marked clean when all previously logged follow-ups are closed and labelled `ai:merged`, even though the current audit still reports findings.
  WHY: A subsequent audit can report `findings > 0` and `followups_created=0` for an unresolved finding, but line 74 treats the merged follow-up as clean and advances to validation.

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:74 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The security pass clean check uses an OR condition that allows a pass to be considered clean when all follow-ups are merged, even if the current audit reports findings > 0.
  WHY: The audit can deduplicate a still-present finding against a closed issue, leaving the finding unfixed while the pass advances to validation; the test `test_security_clean_pass_checks_earlier_followups` at line 313 validates that this text is present, but doesn't validate the logic.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:line 74, step 9 clean-pass rule: "the pass is clean, and you go to step 10, when the run audited and its run line reports `findings=0`, or when every follow-up issue the log's `## Security pass` lists from earlier cycles is closed and labelled `ai:merged`" | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The OR condition allows a clean pass when `findings > 0` as long as every earlier follow-up is merged.
  WHY: A re-detected finding can remain in the audit while its existing marker suppresses a new follow-up, letting the project advance to validation with an unfixed security finding.

=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
